verdict.rationale:
CockroachDB Cloud's Serverless/Basic tier explicitly scales Request Unit consumption to zero when idle, while data remains durably stored and billed only for storage, directly matching the story of a free-when-idle prototype database. Docs also show a $400 free trial credit and cluster management dashboards for tracking usage, reinforcing the cost-to-zero model for founders/side projects.

Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of actual $0 billing behavior during idle periods, and no community reports validating the scale-to-zero claim in practice (only docs-level evidence).
